subtitle: Daily One Line Logic Game
promotionalText: Drag the kitty through every square, passing 1 → 2 → 3 in order. A new puzzle every day, endless levels, unlimited undo.
description:
Draw one line. Fill every square. Follow the numbers.

Kitty Path is a calm logic puzzle with just two rules:
• Your line must pass through every square exactly once
• It must pass the numbers in order: 1 → 2 → 3 …

Drag the kitty from 1 and finish on the biggest number. Every puzzle has exactly one solution.

■ A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Today's Puzzle is the same for everyone. Solve it daily to keep your streak going.

■ ENDLESS LEVELS
Start with quick 5×5 boards and work up to 8×8. Levels never run out, and they are all free.

■ NO MISTAKES, NO STRESS
Slide back over your line to erase it. Undo and Clear are always free and unlimited — no coins, no timers you can fail.

■ HINTS THAT ACTUALLY HELP
Stuck? Watch a short video and the app draws the real way to the next number, fixing any wrong turns.

■ PLAY ANYWHERE
Works offline — perfect for the bus, the subway or a coffee break. No account, no sign-in.
reviewNotes:
One-line number puzzle game. No account or login.

How to play: drag from the square marked 1 (the kitty) to draw a line through every square exactly once, passing the numbers in order and ending on the biggest number. Slide back over the line to erase; Undo / Clear buttons at the bottom.

Modes: Today's Puzzle (one new 6x6 board per day, same for everyone) and Levels (endless, 5x5 to 8x8), all free.

Ads: Google AdMob banner + optional rewarded video for a hint (draws the way to the next number). If no video is available, the hint is granted anyway. The app does not request tracking permission.

No backend server; puzzles are generated on the device. English only.
